newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 1.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Back-to-school fever as one million pupils in Ivory Coast start new academic year today - Fight against violent crime and insecurity: Ruling PDCI party donates 30 robust vehicles to police for border patrol. - Law on police searches of homes to recover firearms as part of fight against insecurity adopted by parliament yesterday. Opposition and human rights groups opposed the law for allowing police to carry out searches at any time of day or night without a search warrant. - Economic growth in franc-zone states of West Africa positive but debt still unsustainable LA VOIE - Shortage of domestic gas threatens school canteens as one million pupils return to class today. LE JOUR - Regional producers of banana, pineaple and mango end meeting devoted to reflection on depressed state of their market. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
